text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Evening. On my way back from shopping for 
some extra training gear we'd run out of—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Seems awfully noisy over that way...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a raffle, is it? Come to think of it, 
during my shopping earlier, I received 
what appeared to be a ticket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Since we have the chance, shall we give 
it a try? Now then, Trainer――"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm the one drawing the lottery ticket? 
Not you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, I do not dislike it! It is just 
that... the thought had never crossed my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was usually the one just watching from 
the sidelines with stuff like this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... She looked really adorable when it 
hit her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That was back when she was still shy and 
quiet. When she won a prize, she actually 
shouted 'Yay!' for once...
choice_data_list: Today it's your turn to go 'Yay!'
Today it's your turn to go "Hooray!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I may not be able to live up to 
those expectations, however.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide eagerly stepped up to the 
raffle machine and spun the lever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Oh, I won...! The grand prize...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine. I'm just still in a bit of a 
daze."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, the grand prize... Assuming each 
lottery machine holds roughly 300 balls, 
the grand prize ball is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Just one, right!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We won a 1-in-300 chance with just a 
single ticket...?!
choice_data_list: It just means we got lucky!
It just means luck was on our side!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: U-Um……

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hot spring trip tickets, though, huh...? 
Hmm, once things settle down after a 
while, I'd certainly like to use them, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah. S-Sorry! You received this, so you 
have the right to go with someone else 
too, of course! Why on earth did I assume 
you'd go with me...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haa... It's no use. It seems the shock is 
still lingering in my head.
choice_data_list: Either way is fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... You're leaving it to me?! 
M-mmgh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then, at the appropriate time. Perhaps 
after the Twinkle Series concludes, we 
shall consider "who should use it, and 
how."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...If we're both free, then. We can 
figure it out when the time comes."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide carefully put away the hot 
springs trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes! Trainer-kun!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Impressive, right? Even I can win 
first—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* Admittedly, I can understand the 
urge to jump for joy upon winning first 
prize.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I won this Salisbury steak with a ticket 
I got while out buying training 
equipment."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then it would only be right for the two of 
us to split it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Very well. However, you must keep how I 
acted just now a secret.
choice_data_list: You want me to keep quiet...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "N-No! Please!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If word got around to my sister that her 
older sister was getting all hyped up over 
a raffle at this age... well, she'd 
probably die of embarrassment too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After making that promise to Biwa 
Hayahide, the two of us enjoyed the carrot 
hamburg steak together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... That's quite a lot. With this much, 
we won't have to worry about carrots for a 
while, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Since we're here, and as a token of my 
daily appreciation, would you mind if I 
shared some with you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you figured it out without me even 
saying it? That's right, it's those two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Tickeeet! Taishiiin!! Over hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer. First, Ticket will be 
charging in at full speed. Take care not 
to get run over, okay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAAAANNNGG!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun?! Ticket?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I shared the massive pile of 
carrots with Winning Ticket and Narita 
Taishin as well.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, yeah. Right, even if it's only 3rd 
prize, I'm glad I managed to pull it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide snapped the 3rd-prize carrot 
in half, and we decided to split it evenly 
at 0.5 each.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh... Tissues...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...M-Mmh... However, taking on the 
challenge taught me a few things.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When my sister lost the lottery, she 
looked so downcast, which was cute in its 
own way, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I never realized how heartbreaking it felt 
to be the one who lost the draw...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Comforting Biwa Hayahide as she slumped 
her shoulders, we left the shopping 
district behind...
